pages.text: $(bold)Order of Origin$() (comes with Origin Alloy armor, $(bold)no levels$())$(br2)Effect: $(bold)any damage you take is recomputed as physical damage$() before it lands on you, so it goes through your $(bold)armor points / toughness / protection enchantments / curios and attributes$() as usual.$(br2)Typical use: damage that used to ignore armor (magic, true damage, and so on) must now get past your plate first.$(br2)$(bold)Scope note$(): this covers $(bold)damage that goes through damage events$() (practically all combat damage); effects that bypass events and write your health directly are not covered.$(br2)$(italic)Order first, then the wound.$()
